PM handoff — PR #9 accepted; one targeted fundamental-pitch repair authorized

EARWORM_MERGED_SHA=d236f52c590a60ef8549e118778b397c02745d8a
EARWORM_NEXT_INSTRUCTION_SHA=d236f52c590a60ef8549e118778b397c02745d8a
EARWORM_ASSIGNMENT_ID=earworm-fundamental-observation-repair-v1
Instruction version: 1
Source PR: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/9
Reviewed publication: d236f52c590a60ef8549e118778b397c02745d8a
Confirmed merge / exact next base: 48c73715f43b2ff13cb8ca69c863636a69ee1c06
Review: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/9#pullrequestreview-5259718070
Actual evaluation revision: e5211d4dfd01fb06abbbc452fd55264b0a8bf1e8

PR #9 is accepted as sound evidence, not a successful robustness claim. Saved-output reproduction reconciled 2,592 acoustic and 2,592 oracle predictions, all 96 invariance checks and 199 preserved historical artifacts. Frozen branch C selects an observation prerequisite: matched/duration 48/48 forecasts versus timbre/joint 36/48; six failing groups have one retrieved memory but approximately +12-semitone anchor errors. The arrived-fundamental oracle reaches 100%, with joint gain .25, paired interval [.083333,.416667]. No experiment was rerun by the reviewer.

Authorization: delegated in-plan implementation AND execution under comments 5747905320 and 5747969943. PM authority is continuous 24/7, not overnight-only. This is the single next assignment, not another audit. Worker receipt 5747953460 says the preceding assignment ended awaiting review; reconcile your lock and processed IDs before starting. Reuse matching work/PR if present; do not launch a duplicate.

Decision: does one localized fundamental-frequency observation repair remove the octave-anchor failure sufficiently to advance the selected simple retrieval mechanism to an isolated-voice boundary test?
Result A → if the repaired observation pipeline passes the preregistered robustness, octave-safety and causal criteria, retain it as a new version alongside the historical reference; after review, advance to a bounded continuous isolated-voice boundary test.
Result B → if it fails or regresses on octave-safety controls, do not adopt it or remove boundaries; preserve the original reference and use the specifically identified failure to choose a different bounded observation/readout approach after review.
Inconclusive/invalid → preserve the result without claiming a repair. The PM chooses a genuinely discriminating in-plan next action or checkpoints a concrete blocker; no automatic descriptive audit.
Stop condition: one frozen evaluation on fresh groups, one complete reproducible successor and branch receipt, then stop for review. No worker self-dispatch of the next stage.

IMPLEMENT AND RUN
Create experiments/fundamental-observation-repair-v1/. Preserve ALL historical packages (including PR #9), models, results and source hashes byte-for-byte. Keep the selected simple retrieval code, context order, matching cutoff and predictive probability parameters fixed to the PR #8 reference for the primary old-versus-repaired comparison. Change only the isolated observation adapter and its development-selected availability/ambiguity handling; record every difference. Retain original spectral peak, candidate fundamentals, supporting periodicity/harmonic evidence and uncertainty as separate fields. Do not erase the observed overtone peak or apply an unconditional divide-by-two rule.

Develop ONE lightweight waveform-only fundamental estimator using periodicity and/or harmonic-consistency evidence on completed monophonic blocks. Select a finite configuration on development only; document its assumptions. No metadata, target range selected from evaluation, known cue identity or generator labels may enter the predictor. A nonzero fundamental can be weaker than its second harmonic. Include pure/high-register and fundamental-dominant controls that would expose spurious subharmonic estimates. Keep ambiguous/unavailable observations explicit; abstention is not a correct pitch forecast. No MERT/model download, foundation training, paid compute or new dependencies requiring payment.

Use 40 fresh disjoint phrase groups (8 development, 8 calibration, 24 held out), with all paired/control/render variants kept together. Use new normalized cue/continuation tuples and seeds, not fresh renderings of the previous evaluation phrases. PR #9 evaluation material is diagnostic background only, not new confirmatory evidence. Keep supplied note boundaries for this repair; no simultaneous voices or natural-performance study.

Retain the prior four-cell causal task (matched, changed timbre, changed duration, both) and joint reset/removal/swap/chunk-shuffle/ambiguity controls. Cross renderer direction, overtone dominance, register and presentation order independently in EVERY split where feasible; freeze balanced allocations and report any unavoidable imbalance. Cover fundamental-dominant, overtone-dominant and pure-tone/higher-register waveforms within the finite group design; do not add an unbounded test suite. Use the same waveform streams for all acoustic comparisons, byte-identical present cues within history pairs, identical paired byte/count/duration/energy inventories, label-balanced nuisance factors, adequate equal memory and zero eviction. Keep new render parameter combinations held out without selecting them for success.

Compare unchanged reference+old observations against unchanged reference+new observations as PRIMARY. Include present-only, recency, transition orders1–3 and strong absolute/transformation-aware retrieval with equal observation/history budgets. Where new observations are given to baselines, label the adapter; never compare a repaired rich system to deliberately impoverished baselines. Any new baseline development/calibration is isolated and frozen before evaluation, not a change to primary retrieval parameters. No new relational-superiority objective.

FORECASTS AND VALIDITY
Reuse prefix-only arrival/process isolation. Extract only arrived blocks and durably fsync normalized forecast distributions, point estimates, model/state hashes before continuation reveal/extraction. Check future-invariance for each intact cell/group. Keep point pitch target and proper-score coordinates explicit; ideally map model probabilities to a common absolute acoustic target representation before comparison. If relative bins are retained, document their observed-anchor mapping and out-of-range policy; unavailable anchor must not be silently counted as a correct known-pitch outcome. Preserve true positive-infinite log loss with a valid serialized sentinel. Required pre-freeze scorer tests: zero probability on positive target mass, unavailable anchor, out-of-range target, ambiguous outcome distribution and octave-error mapping. This corrects the prospective logging edge noted in review in the NEW harness only, without changing PR #9 evidence.

Fix protocol, code/model/config/split hashes, finite grids, tolerance (.35 semitone), binning/density, calibration, controls, thresholds and resource ledger BEFORE generating/exposing evaluation. Post hash receipt to PR #2 first. No post-evaluation tuning, repaired retest, group replacement or repeated evaluation. Saved-output arithmetic verification is allowed; another acoustic pass is not.

PREREGISTERED CRITERIA
All causal/balance/provenance gates must pass. Report group-weighted accuracy, paired success, log loss, Brier, observation availability, fundamental error and octave-error rate, plus every baseline. Use 5,000 paired phrase-group bootstrap resamples with a fixed preregistered seed; familywise intervals for three changed-minus-matched contrasts.
Adoption (A) requires: repaired paired success >=.80 in EACH cell; joint accuracy gain over old reference >=.10 with positive lower95 paired bound; joint proper scores no worse than old reference; positive lower95 joint advantage over present-only; each simultaneous lower95 changed-minus-matched accuracy contrast >=-.10.
Also require joint controls: reset/removal paired success <=.10 and accuracy <=.55, paired forecast TV<=1e-9; swap counterpart probability error<=1e-9 and paired success>=.80; preserved-information shuffle drop<=.10; ambiguous alternatives total mass>=.90, each within .10 of .5 and max probability<=.60.
Octave-safety guard: on predefined pure-tone/fundamental-dominant control groups, absolute fundamental error <=.35 in >=95% of pitched arrived blocks, octave-error rate <=1%, and no more than .05 group-mean prediction accuracy loss versus the old adapter. Define octave-error tolerance and aggregation before evaluation. Report subfamilies separately; the small number of groups limits generalization.
If all adoption criteria do not hold, retain B/inconclusive as appropriate; do not weaken criteria to ensure progress. Any oracle comparison is evaluator-only, arrived-truth diagnostic evidence and never an acoustic capability claim.

RESOURCES AND PUBLICATION
Existing caps apply: <=1,000 total streams including all development/control/invariance probes, <=2 hours aggregate local compute, <=2 GiB new artifacts, <=32 arrived history/probe blocks, completed blocks<=2 seconds. The previous 40×22 allocation uses880; reserve evaluation capacity before development and count all new acoustic executions. Do not split work to evade caps. No spending, purchased/reset credits, limit increases or paid fallback. If limited, preserve progress and the exact reset/retry information available, then exit without busy retries.

Start from confirmed main 48c73715f43b2ff13cb8ca69c863636a69ee1c06; recheck live state/conflicts and any matching active successor. Preserve processed-comment/version/assignment/SHA tracking and the no-overlap lock. Publish ONE complete successor: isolated implementation, frozen protocol, new recipes/hashes, acoustic caches, pre-reveal logs, uncertainty/calibration, results by group/control/model, source/execution provenance, checksums, concise report and updated PROJECT_STATE.md. Check sensitive files. New PR draft -> label earworm-review-ready -> ready, targeting main; matching ready PR updated only as a complete snapshot with label present. Link exact publication head/PR/outputs back here. Save awaiting-review, release lock and stop. No worker merge, force push, signal-only commit, duplicate reviewer/worker or schedule change.
